clue.text: For destruction, I must dare box using both hands

indicators.note: destruction breaks the words apart, so their letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is urged to box, daringly, purely to wreck things, using both fists.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambidextrous person can use either hand equally well, so two-handed skill fits.

clue.text: Cocktail — a White Russian!

parts.note: reads as a vodka drink order, but means the Soviet minister whose name went on a petrol-bomb cocktail; the exclamation mocks calling that Bolshevik White

explanation.surface: Someone orders a White Russian at the bar.
explanation.walkthrough: A White Russian is a vodka-and-coffee cocktail; but the cocktail meant is the improvised petrol bomb named after a Soviet foreign minister, a Red rather than a White.
explanation.definitionFit: The improvised firebomb bears the surname of Stalin's foreign minister, a Russian statesman.

clue.text: I next admit through being ignorant

indicators.note: to admit is to let in, so the first words take the next piece inside them

parts.note: per means through or by way of, as in 'per post'

explanation.surface: Someone admits the next person through, rather unknowingly.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking skill or know-how, an unskilled person is untrained and uninformed.

clue.text: Lizards eat fish then sunbathe initially

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of each of the words before it

explanation.surface: Lizards feed on fish and then bask in the sun.
explanation.walkthrough: Newts are often called efts in crosswords; strictly they are amphibians, not lizards, but older usage lumps them together.
explanation.definitionFit: An eft is a young newt, loosely called a lizard in older usage.

clue.text: Making firm gouge with ninth operation

indicators.note: an operation works on the letters, rearranging them into a new word

explanation.surface: A surgeon describes gouging during the ninth operation of the day.
explanation.definitionFit: To toughen is to harden or strengthen, so firming up is the same process.

clue.text: Put chalk here at the right time

definitions.meaning: snooker players chalk the tip of the stick they strike with, so chalk goes onto that stick
punctual, exactly when signalled, like an actor's entrance

explanation.definitionFit: Chalk goes on the snooker stick; and an actor entering at the signal arrives punctually.

clue.text: Sample of blister I leave free of germs

indicators.note: Sample of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A patient leaves a blister sample for testing, hoping it is clean.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sterile has been disinfected so no microbes survive on it.

clue.text: Ministry in exotic place

parts.note: exotic things come from abroad, i.e. are foreign
an office is a place of work, or a post someone holds

explanation.surface: A government department is housed somewhere exotic.
explanation.walkthrough: The UK department handling relations with other countries was long known by this name.
explanation.definitionFit: The British department for overseas affairs is a government ministry.

clue.text: Unfortunately, trust is danger with this antibiotic

definitions.text: Unfortunately, trust is danger with this antibiotic

indicators.note: things going unfortunately are going wrong, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A warning that over-reliance on this antibiotic is risky.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: bacteria that shrug off medicines make trusting the antibiotic dangerous.
explanation.definitionFit: Bacteria unaffected by medicines make relying on an antibiotic dangerous.

clue.text: Section of soil I establish to be the most greasy

indicators.note: Section of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A soil scientist determines which section of ground is greasiest.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of oily means having the greatest amount of grease.

clue.text: Cloudy following nuclear explosion

indicators.note: an explosion blows the word apart, scattering its letters into a new order

explanation.surface: The sky turns murky after a nuclear blast.
explanation.definitionFit: Unclear water or sky is murky and hard to see through, just as cloudy is.

clue.text: Legal bar is French work

parts.note: est is the French for 'is'
op, short for opus, is a work of music

explanation.surface: A bar in law is described as French workmanship.
explanation.definitionFit: To estop is a legal term for precluding someone from asserting something, a bar in law.

clue.text: Spinning branch about scoundrel

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece goes round the other

parts.note: a wing is a branch of an organisation or building
a heel is a contemptible person, a cad

explanation.surface: A branch of a firm deals with some rogue.
explanation.definitionFit: Wheeling birds turn in circles, rotating as if on an axle.

clue.text: Promoter of endless strike by a city

indicators.note: endless means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: to impress is to strike someone's mind, or to stamp
Rio de Janeiro is the Brazilian city

explanation.surface: A promoter talks of a never-ending strike staged by a city's workers.
explanation.definitionFit: An impresario stages concerts or shows, organising and funding them.

clue.text: Without success, strong men struggle to win day of victory for regime

indicators.note: to win is to gain or take in, so the jumble takes the next piece inside
the men struggling are thrown into disorder, so the letters are rearranged
without means lacking, so a letter is dropped from the words that follow

parts.note: S is a common abbreviation for success
VE Day, Victory in Europe Day, 8 May 1945

explanation.surface: Tough men who fail must fight to win the victory day for the regime.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove S from STRONG MEN, then rearrange the remaining letters around VE.
explanation.definitionFit: A government is the ruling authority, the regime in power.

clue.text: Distribute note after note

indicators.note: after puts the first note behind the second in the answer

parts.note: me (or mi) is the third note of the sol-fa scale
te (or ti) is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Notes are handed out one after another.
explanation.definitionFit: To mete out is to allot or dole out shares.

clue.text: I am caught by stiff breeze in abortive attempt

indicators.note: being caught by something means being held inside it

parts.note: the mistral is a strong cold wind of southern France

explanation.surface: Someone is caught by a strong wind while making a failed attempt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'am' is just a link word here.
explanation.definitionFit: A trial declared void before verdict is a court hearing that fails.

clue.text: Semi-precious stone gets no companion

parts.note: O, the figure zero, means nothing
a pal is a friend

explanation.surface: A gemstone is left without a partner.
explanation.definitionFit: Opals are milky iridescent gems, classed as semi-precious.

clue.text: Chose exercise in fuss over small boy

indicators.note: in places the exercise inside the other pieces
in a down clue, over means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: ado means fuss or bother, as in 'much ado'
Ed is a short form of Edward
PT is physical training

explanation.surface: Someone opted for a workout amid a fuss about a little boy.
explanation.definitionFit: To adopt is to take up or select something as one's own.

clue.text: Troubled from afar, pining for this perfume

indicators.note: troubled means disturbed, so the letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone homesick and distant longs for a favourite scent.
explanation.definitionFit: Frangipani is a tropical flower whose fragrance is used in scents.

clue.text: Tree-worshipper, perhaps, destroys car in a street

indicators.note: in places the wrecked car inside the other pieces
destroying the car smashes it up, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: the Mini is a classic small British car

explanation.surface: A tree-worshipper wrecks a car parked on a street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' marks the definition as an example: animists see spirits in trees but in other things too.
explanation.definitionFit: Animists believe natural objects such as trees hold spirits, so they may venerate them.

clue.text: Wax like powder?

parts.note: flour is powdered grain
the suffix -ish means like or somewhat

explanation.surface: Is wax something like a powder?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wax' means grow, as the moon waxes, not polish.
explanation.definitionFit: To wax is to grow or thrive, as the moon increases.

clue.text: Controls through spoken commands

indicators.note: spoken means the word is heard, so a sound-alike is wanted

parts.note: reigns means rules or commands as a monarch

explanation.surface: Someone controls things through voiced orders.
explanation.definitionFit: Reins are the straps a rider steers a horse with, so they are controls.

clue.text: It is not commonly dirty

definitions.meaning: a colloquial contraction of 'it ain't', informal for 'it isn't'
to soil or contaminate, as a verb

explanation.definitionFit: Dialect contraction for 'it isn't'; and to taint is to contaminate or spoil.

clue.text: Foundations of a small county

definitions.meaning: ... of rock or concrete are the layers things rest on
an abbreviated name of Bedfordshire, an English county north of London; small signals the shortening

explanation.definitionFit: Base layers are bases; and the abbreviation names Bedfordshire, an English county.

clue.text: Whip lash before run is more spiteful

parts.note: the cat-o'-nine-tails is a whip, cat for short
to lash is to tie or bind
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A whipping before running is described as nastier.
explanation.definitionFit: Catty remarks are malicious, so the comparative means nastier.

clue.text: Make copy of bone in iodine solution

indicators.note: in puts the bone inside the rearranged letters
a solution dissolves things, so the letters are mixed into a new order

parts.note: T as in a T-bone, the T-shaped bone in a steak

explanation.surface: A lab worker makes a copy of a bone soaked in iodine solution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make' and 'of' are link words; the definition is 'copy', one item of a print run.
explanation.definitionFit: An edition is one printing of a book, so a single copy can be called one.

clue.text: Forlorn circle above sun goddess

parts.note: a disc is a flat circle
on means upon or above
Sol is the sun, Latin and Roman god
Ate is the Greek goddess of mischief and ruin

explanation.surface: A ring sits above a sun goddess figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone forlorn is sad beyond comfort, utterly dejected.
